_citation: U.S. Standard Atmosphere, 1976. NOAA, NASA and USAF, NOAA-S/T 76-1562, U.S. Government Printing Office, Washington D.C., October 1976. NASA-TM-X-74335, NTRS 19770009539. Transcribed from the NTRS scan (pdf pages given as 'pdf N'; report page numbers in parentheses).

table2_constants._where: Table 2 'Adopted constants', pdf 18 (report p. 2); r0 from the text under eq. 17, pdf 24 (p. 8)

table3_composition._where: Table 3 'Molecular weights and assumed fractional-volume composition of sea-level dry air', pdf 19 (p. 3)
table3_composition._M0_where: text of section 1.2.4, pdf 25 (p. 9): 'M0 is found to be 28.9644 kg/kmol'

table4_layers._where: Table 4 'The defined reference levels and gradients of the linearly segmented temperature-height profile from the surface to 86 geometric kilometers', pdf 19 (p. 3); eq. 23 T_M = T_M,b + L_M,b (H - H_b), pdf 26 (p. 10)

equations.eq18: H = (g0/g0') r0 Z / (r0 + Z), with g0/g0' = 1 m'/m
equations.eq33b: P = P_b exp[-g0' M0 (H - H_b) / (R* T_M,b)]   (L_M,b = 0)
equations.number_density: N = N_A P / (R* T), T = T_M M/M0 (the ideal-gas law with the constants of Table 2)

table8_molecular_weight_ratio._where: Table 8 'Molecular-weight ratio geopotential and geometric altitudes in meters', pdf 25 (p. 9), geometric-altitude half (Z, M/M0). The text there states that the tables of the Standard below 86 km were computed WITHOUT this ratio (T = T_M), so their 80-86 km number densities are high by up to 0.04 %.

table18_ozone._where: Table 18 'Mid-latitude ozone model', pdf 54 (p. 38): geometric height Z and ozone number density n(O3) with its standard deviation sigma (m^-3). Description pdf 53 (p. 37): balloon soundings (51 deg longitude band Seattle-Bedford, below 27 km) and 20 rocket soundings (mean latitude 38 N, 1949-1972, above 27 km, adjusted to 45 N with satellite latitudinal gradients); 'weighted towards the solar maximum conditions which existed in the late 1960's'; total ozone 0.345 atm-cm, 'about five percent more than ... the global network of Dobson spectrophotometers for 45 N'.
table18_ozone._total_where: Table 18 footer and text p. 37: 0.345 atm-cm = 9.27e22 molecules/m^2

checks._where: Table I 'Geometric Altitude, Metric Units' and Table II 'Geopotential Altitude, Metric Units' (Part 4 main tables). Z geometric (m), H geopotential (m'), n number density (m^-3), rho density (kg/m^3), T (K), g (m/s^2).
